note: Short timed runs of poses, wrist positions and palm directions, dropped at the playhead in the hand editor (dt = seconds from the moment of the hit). check: sourced = the move and its hand action are named in a source; knowledge = from general knowledge, no source describes it; estimate = timing only. All timings are animation estimates; correct what looks wrong.

moves.label: Finger snap
moves.text: Thumb loads on the middle finger, then the finger slaps the palm.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Finger flick
moves.text: Index loaded under the thumb, then flicked out.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Clench and release
moves.text: A hard clench, then the hand pops open.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Burst
moves.text: A tight fist explodes into wide fingers.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Finger wave
moves.text: The fingers close one after another from the pinky, then open.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Jazz-hands shake
moves.text: Spread and claw alternating fast, about eight changes a second.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Finger tap
moves.text: The fingers drum, one after another: pinky, ring, middle, index.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Wrist flick down
moves.text: The hand cocks back, then flicks down.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Wrist flick up
moves.text: The hand drops, then flicks up.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Wrist wave
moves.text: The hand swings toward the thumb and the pinky and back, about three times a second.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Wrist circle
moves.text: The hand draws a circle: in, toward the pinky, back, toward the thumb.
moves.source: the editor's own gestures (timings are animation estimates)

moves.label: Point
moves.text: One arm shoots out from the opposite shoulder and the finger points, held for a moment (the hand is fist-loose before, relaxed after).
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance), Moves section (the arm); the hand shape is my reading

moves.label: Wrist twirl
moves.text: The wrists twirl while the arms move upward: the hand circles on the wrist, loose, about four times a second.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance), Moves section (named, with the wrists twirling); the timing is an estimate

moves.label: Pacing
moves.text: The wrist stays loose and the arm tight: quick jabs to the side, the hand swinging toward the thumb and the little finger.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance), Moves section (wrist loose, arm tight); the timing is an estimate

moves.label: Hitch hike
moves.text: The thumb jabs out to the side, then back into the fist.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance), Moves section (the thumbs jab out right and left); one hand shown

moves.label: Floor sweep
moves.text: A flat hand wipes across, palm down.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance), Moves section (one hand moves across the floor like wiping)

moves.label: Up lock (muscle man)
moves.text: Fists raised above the shoulders in a macho pose, held, then loosened.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance), Moves section (arms raised above the shoulders); the fists are my reading

moves.label: Funky guitar
moves.text: The hand grips as if on a guitar neck.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance), Moves section (hands held as if gripping a guitar)

moves.label: Hit (hand pop)
moves.text: A muscle contraction that jerks the hand: the fingers flare for an instant, the wrist kicks back, then everything relaxes.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) / Tutting (popping is a quick contraction and release); the hand detail is from general knowledge

moves.label: Tut angle: hand in
moves.text: A right angle at the wrist: the flat hand folds in at about 70 degrees and holds.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) / Tutting (tutting forms right angles with the arms, hands and wrists); the angle is my reading

moves.label: Tut angle: hand back
moves.text: A right angle the other way: the flat hand bends back and holds.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) / Tutting (tutting forms right angles); the angle is my reading

moves.label: Hand wave (waving)
moves.text: A wave arriving in the hand: the wrist passes in, level, back, level.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) / Tutting (waving is named, not described); from general knowledge

moves.label: Strobe
moves.text: Stop-motion stutter: the fingers flick between open and claw in held steps, about eight a second.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) / Tutting (strobing is named, not described); from general knowledge

moves.label: Finger gun
moves.text: The hand makes a gun, with a small recoil at the wrist.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop gesture)

moves.label: Jab
moves.text: A short, sharp push out from the chest and back with the same energy: the fist tightens at the end.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Krumping (the jab is described as an arm movement; the fist is my reading)

moves.label: Arm swing (loose hand)
moves.text: The arm sweeps with gravity and the hand trails behind it, then catches up.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Krumping (arm swings are described as sweeping, like a bat); the trailing hand is my reading

moves.label: Cabbage Patch
moves.text: Fists circle beside the head: closed hands, the wrist rolling around.
moves.source: general knowledge (named in Wikipedia: Hip-hop dance, not described)

moves.label: Dougie hair stroke
moves.text: The hand strokes the hair back from the forehead, palm in, wrist rolling.
moves.source: a dance guide's description (a hand raised near the head as if stroking the hair back); the wrist is my reading

moves.label: Money rub
moves.text: The thumb rubs the fingertips, as counting money.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop gesture)

moves.label: Finger wave (index to pinky)
moves.text: The fingers close one after another from the index finger to the pinky, then open: the finger wave the other way.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Finger flutter
moves.text: The fingers flutter between open and spread-claw very fast, about 16 changes a second.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Thumb flick
moves.text: The thumb snaps out of the fist and back in.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Count one to five
moves.text: The fingers come up one at a time: one, two, three, four, five, a quarter of a second each.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Grab
moves.text: The open hand claws and closes hard on something.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: High five
moves.text: The hand slaps out, fingers wide, palm forward, and holds for a moment.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Push (stop hand)
moves.text: A flat hand pushes out, palm forward, the wrist cocked back: stop.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Palm flip
moves.text: The forearm rolls and the palm flips from down to up.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Forearm roll
moves.text: The palm turns through down, out, up and in: a full roll of the forearm.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Wrist circle (reverse)
moves.text: The hand draws the wrist circle the other way round.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Wrist shake
moves.text: The loose hand shakes on the wrist, about 16 changes a second.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Wrist bounce
moves.text: The hand bounces on the wrist in time: in, back, in, back, a beat apart.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Wrist whip
moves.text: The hand is thrown back, then whips down and settles.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Wrist hit toward the little finger
moves.text: A sharp sideways hit of the hand toward the little finger, held, then released.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Wrist hit toward the thumb
moves.text: A sharp sideways hit of the hand toward the thumb, held, then released.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Lock (freeze)
moves.text: The hand flares and then stops dead, as the whole body does on a lock.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance) (the lock is a sudden pause); the hand is my reading

moves.label: Stop and go: punch
moves.text: A punch thrown at the stop: the loose fist snaps tight, palm down.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance) (Stop and Go mentions a punch); the hand is my reading

moves.label: Which-away (flat hands out)
moves.text: The hands are held flat out in front, palms down, while the body stays still.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance) (arms out in front, body still); the flat hand is my reading

moves.label: Finger wag
moves.text: A pointing finger wagged from side to side: no, no, no.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Hit (fist)
moves.text: A hit that clenches the hand: the fist snaps tight and the wrist kicks back, then everything relaxes.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Tick
moves.text: Tiny repeated twitches of the hand, about ten a second, each held.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Robot hand
moves.text: Stiff steps at the wrist, each held: back, in, sideways, level.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Stop-motion hand
moves.text: Animation: the hand changes in held, stiff frames, like stop-motion.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Boogaloo hand ripple
moves.text: A slow ripple: the wrist rolls in and back while the fingers close one after another.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Tut angle: toward the little finger
moves.text: A right angle sideways: the flat hand folds toward the little finger and holds.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) / Tutting (tutting forms right angles); the angle is my reading

moves.label: Tut angle: toward the thumb
moves.text: A right angle the other way sideways: the flat hand folds toward the thumb and holds.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) / Tutting (tutting forms right angles); the angle is my reading

moves.label: Finger tut: L shape
moves.text: The thumb and the index finger make an L, the start shape of a finger-tutting sequence.
moves.source: Dance Spirit: P-Nut's beginner finger-tutting sequence (starts with L shapes); one hand shown, the sequence itself needs both hands to touch

moves.label: Buck claw
moves.text: Tense, clawed fingers flung out, the wrist bent back.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Fist snap
moves.text: An open hand snaps into a hard fist.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Throw down
moves.text: A tight fist thrown open, fingers wide, as the arm drives down.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Arm swing (open hand)
moves.text: The arm sweeps and the open hand trails behind, then catches up.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Krumping (arm swings sweep like a bat); the open trailing hand is my reading

moves.label: Plant (hand on the floor)
moves.text: The hand is planted flat on the floor, fingers spread, the wrist bent back to take the weight.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Glossary of dance moves (freezes are poses done on the hands; downrock is footwork with the hands on the floor); the hand is my reading

moves.label: Push off the floor
moves.text: The planted hand pushes off and flicks open.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Grip (hold a leg or the floor)
moves.text: A wide, hard grip on a leg or the floor, held.

moves.label: Fist pump

moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Pull the cord (lawnmower)

moves.label: Cat claws

moves.label: Sprinkler

moves.source: Wikipedia: Glossary of dance moves (the sprinkler simulates a garden sprinkler); the hand is my reading

moves.label: Brush it off the shoulder
moves.text: The hand wipes dirt off the shoulder, palm in, the wrist flicking.
moves.source: general knowledge (a common hip hop move or gesture); the hand detail and the timing are my reading

moves.label: Hands up shake
